subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The employees made a noticeable __hue and cry__ to get their demands raised to the board of Directors.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"hue and cry"** means a loud public outcry or protest. (जोरदार विरोध)

 
 
• **Example: **There was a** hue and cry** from the citizens when the new tax law was introduced.
 
 
 
• **"Protest something" **refers to expressing strong objection or disapproval about an issue or situation. (विरोध करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The students **protested against** the decision to increase tuition fees.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Celebrate an event **(घटना का जश्न मनाना): To mark a special occasion with festivities or other activities.

 
 
• **Example:** They celebrated their anniversary with a grand party.
 
 
 
• **Participate in sports **(खेलों में भाग लेना): To take part in physical activities or games.
 
 
• **Example: **He loves to participate in sports like soccer and basketball.
 
 
 
• **Lie lifeless** (निर्जीव पड़े रहना): To remain without any movement or signs of life.
 
 
• **Example:** The old house lay lifeless and abandoned for years.
